title: FuelTech Boost Controller
tag_line: FuelTech-inspired boost-by-RPM controller with configurable boost targets per RPM range.
message:
FuelTech Boost Controller

A boost-by-RPM controller inspired by FuelTech standalone ECUs. Set boost pressure targets at 6 RPM breakpoints with linear interpolation for smooth transitions.

Features:
- 6 configurable RPM breakpoints
- Adjustable boost target (PSI) at each breakpoint
- Master enable/disable toggle
- Linear interpolation between RPM points
- Works with any turbocharged vehicle

To use: Select in vehicle config under Additional Modification slot.
